description: SIPA publishes research-grade benchmarks for private infrastructure and private equity investors. The home page states 1.3 million private equity and infrastructure assets tracked globally, more than 10,700 indices and benchmarks, and 25 years of private infrastructure price history back to March 2000. The infrastructure equity index is updated monthly from real transaction data and covers more than 9,200 assets, over 650 segment indices under the TICCS classification and 23 ESMA-recognised benchmarks across 25 countries and 33 sectors; the infrastructure debt product gives credit spreads, yields and duration from real transactions, with shadow credit ratings, 103 metrics and more than 3,300 segment indices. Access is through the SIPAmetrics platform on subscription, with demos on request. Caveats: the data are proprietary and paid, and they value infrastructure companies and loans, not describe physical assets. They support economic and financial analysis of infrastructure investment, cost of capital and asset valuation by sector and country; a related record is the GI Hub Infrastructure Monitor.
